# MTD Finder
> Independent guide to Making Tax Digital (MTD) for Income Tax for UK sole traders and landlords, with a filterable directory of all 159 HMRC-recognised MTD software products. Run by Matthew Snow trading as Sno Automations. Not tax advice; all claims link to HMRC/GOV.UK.

## Key facts (source: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/check-if-youre-eligible-for-making-tax-digital-for-income-tax)
- Qualifying income (self-employment + property, before expenses) over £50,000 in 2024-25: MTD from 6 April 2026
- Over £30,000 in 2025-26: from 6 April 2027
- Over £20,000 in 2026-27: from 6 April 2028
- Quarterly update deadlines: 7 August, 7 November, 7 February, 7 May (https://www.gov.uk/guidance/use-making-tax-digital-for-income-tax/send-quarterly-updates)
- Each quarterly update is cumulative from the start of the tax year; a nil update is still required (https://www.gov.uk/guidance/use-making-tax-digital-for-income-tax/send-quarterly-updates)
- No penalty points for late quarterly updates in 2026-27; from 2027-28, 4 points = £200 penalty (https://www.gov.uk/guidance/use-making-tax-digital-for-income-tax/send-quarterly-updates)
- Partnerships: later, timeline not yet set (https://www.gov.uk/guidance/check-if-youre-eligible-for-making-tax-digital-for-income-tax)
- Facts last checked against GOV.UK: 2026-10-16
